VII.), its italic subtitle, and the opening paragraph of the dialogue. The left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: dio manent otiosi, denique aliena fuga & clade conster-nati. Quartum genus, huic aduersum. cùm scilicet ipsaGibbera acies. media acies prominet & incurrit prima in hostem. Graeci ἐπικαμπὴς, flexum dicunt, siue etiam κυρτὴν gibberum. Aelianus: Ἐπικαμπὴς παρέκταξις, ἐπὰν τὰ μέσα τῆς πο-λεμίοις ἐπεσπίπτῃ, τὰ δὲ κέρατα ἐκ τῶν ὀπίσω μερῶν ὀρθια ὑφ' ἑαυτὴν ἔχῃ τεταγμένα: Flexa instructio dicitur, cum media hostibus incidunt, cornua autem retro recta habet col-locata. Hac Annibal in pugnâ Cannensi scitissimè est vsus: sed cum cà quoque arte, vt cornua robustissima haberet & integra seruaret; & medijs denique pulsis, sinu facto, immitteret ea vtrimque legionibus, victoriae suae certam caussam. Quàm vtiliter talia nostri Duces meditentur & vsurpent? & paullatim credo facturos, vt ingenia & institutionem quorundam video, qui succrescunt.
main_text.head: DIALOG. VII.

head.i: Alia quaedam acierum forma. Cuneus, Globus, Forfex, Turris, Serra.

main_text.p: Anam resistis & siles. AVD. Non aliae igitur aut plures Aciei formae? LIPS. Cogito, si quid vtiliter etiam addam. Nam omnia congerere, & figuras ali-quot subtiliter ex Tacticis delineare aut explicare, non est visum: quo fine? Romani raro vsurparunt, & sunt magis inuentiunculae & schematismi ingeniorum. Quaedam tamen apud Romanos etiam vsurpata inter-dum, quae strictim & per indicem dat Cato. Festus ex eo citat: Siue forte opus sit cuneo, aut globo, aut forcipe, aut turribus, aut serra vt adoriare. page.notes: The initial letter of the dialogue is a large A, read as the first letter of "Anam"; the speaker labels AVD. and LIPS. are printed inside the text. The Greek is read from a small scan and the accents and breathings of the Aelian sentence are doubtful, particularly "ἐπικαμπὴς" and "ὀρθια". Signature "m 3" is printed at the foot. The page is the right-hand page of a bound volume, so the left-edge fragments are the neighbouring page.
